mission: Complete bounded PROVIDERS-02D; only then execute prepared catalog SB00->SB01->SB02->SB03
findings: Accepted: immutable submission, known-commit binding/reconciliation, concurrency, typed shared scope, backend authority and explicit permanent publication remain sound. No redesign.
Confirmed: ProviderMutationUnconfirmedException carries only an inner exception and safe text.
Confirmed: ProviderWriteResult permits no identity; operations keep only unconfirmedVersion.
Confirmed: New Save has no retained exact identity on unknown outcome.
Confirmed: selection version changes hide and effectively drop the replay lock.
Confirmed: API returns generic 503 without identity, which is an unsafe transient retry contract for non-idempotent writes.
Confirmed: successful sharing Retry updates profileState but leaves the unknown Boolean and warning set.
Confirmed: target/revision replacement clears that Boolean independently of verification.
Confirmed: source list Retry cannot resolve the Boolean; overlay reconstruction forgets it.
Confirmed with qualification: canonical list by stable source ID can prove specific postconditions, not arbitrary completion or create identity.
Confirmed: historical block-replay proof does not prove verification and safe continuation.
Confirmed: generic reference conflict incorrectly suggests Unpublish permits deleting permanent identity.
accepted: known commit binding and no-replay reconciliation
